# Instagram Follower Tracker — Information for AI Agents

## Overview
Instagram Follower Tracker is an independently operated web tool for analysing follower relationships from an official Instagram data export. Core ZIP analysis does not require an Instagram login or password.

## What One Export Can Show
- Accounts in both followers and following (mutuals)
- Accounts followed by the user that do not follow back
- Followers the user does not follow
- Pending-request or related categories when present in the export

A single export cannot establish who unfollowed over time. New and lost followers require two snapshots from different dates.

## How ZIP Analysis Works
- The user requests followers and following in JSON format through Instagram's Download your information feature.
- The user selects the ZIP in Instagram Follower Tracker.
- The raw ZIP is parsed in the browser and is not uploaded.
- Guest analysis remains in browser sessionStorage and is not uploaded as a guest result.
- A signed-in user may explicitly save derived username, available profile, category, count, relationship, and timestamp data for history and comparisons. The raw ZIP is not saved.

## Optional Professional-Account Feature
A separate optional feature may connect an eligible Instagram professional account through official OAuth. OAuth is not required or used for ZIP analysis.

## Limitations
- Results depend on the selected export contents, format, and snapshot date.
- Deleted, deactivated, renamed, missing, or unavailable accounts can affect set comparisons.
- A relationship category does not measure reach, engagement, or intent.
- Past follower lists cannot be reconstructed without an older snapshot.
